post_messages: post messages in HuggingFace Hub discussions to notify users about parquet conversion
post_messages_on_parquet_conversion: create Hub discussions for datasets recently converted to parquet format
create_discussion_description: create a markdown discussion description with parquet links and bot name
create_link: create a markdown link to a HuggingFace dataset commit or tree revision
limit_to_one_dataset_per_namespace: filter a list of datasets to keep only one per namespace
